questions.question: The first component of the ordered pair (5, 7) is
questions.explanation: In (a, b), the first component is a.

questions.question: If A × A = {(1,1),(1,2),(2,1),(2,2)}, then A equals
questions.explanation: A × A has 4 elements ⇒ |A|² = 4 ⇒ |A| = 2. The distinct first components are 1, 2.

questions.question: log_e(e²) equals
questions.explanation: log_e(e^x) = x by definition. Here x = 2.

questions.question: The range of f(x) = |x − 3| is
questions.explanation: Absolute value is always ≥ 0; minimum 0 at x = 3.
